Lightweight Construction

For the latest iteration of Venta R, we based the frame on Torayca T700 carbon fibers for both frame and fork paired with in mold bearing housing with no additional inserts.

This allows us to create a light and durable bike to enhance maneuverability making it easier for riders to handle across all frame sizes.

3B Clamp System Gen 2

A totally hidden fixing solution that is invisible on the frame, intertwining technological and aesthetic innovation.
